item.title: Anthropic IPO Fails to Calm AI Jitters
item.description: Seaport Research Partners Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub tells Bloomberg This Weekend the sharp AI-driven market selloff looks overdone, arguing that demand for computing power remains strong and semiconductor earnings expectations continue to rise. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Golub says a bigger challenge is whether markets can keep financing the enormous capital needs of AI companies as investors are asked to fund hundreds of billions of dollars in new infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Just Ice Tea Builds on Honest Tea’s Legacy
item.description: Just Ice Tea co-founders Seth Goldman and Spike Mendelsohn tell Bloomberg This Weekend how they built the organic tea brand after Coca-Cola discontinued Honest Tea and are expanding with Awaken, a cold-brew tea with 120 milligrams of caffeine. Speaking with host Lisa Mateo, they discuss changing consumer tastes, their approach to organic and fair-trade sourcing and why they see room for a mission-driven brand in the growing ready-to-drink tea market. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Putin Gains From Trump, Xi Summit Spotlight
item.description: Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Jeff Mason tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Vladimir Putin emerged as a key beneficiary of his historic meeting with President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, returning to the global stage alongside the US and Chinese leaders despite Russia’s continuing war in Ukraine. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mason says the summit reflected Trump’s preference for leader-level diplomacy and explains why a Democratic-controlled Congress and Stephen Miller’s appointment as White House chief of staff are unlikely to fundamentally change the president’s foreign policy approach. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump’s Putin Ties Draw Focus After Summit
item.description: Bloomberg Economics Analyst Alex Kokcharov tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump’s historic meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping produced limited concrete results despite a joint declaration on energy, nuclear risks and other global issues. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kokcharov explains what Trump’s relationship with Putin means for Ukraine as Europe takes on more of Kyiv’s support and the war intensifies after Ukraine’s latest attack on the Crimean Bridge. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: 'Raise Taxes, Cut Spending': Bill Dudley on the Debt
item.description: As US debt costs continue to soar, former New York Fed President Bill Dudley and Kathryn Judge of Columbia Law School discuss how to address America’s fiscal crisis, and whether Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s efforts to bring yields under control will pay off. (Source: Bloomberg)
